competitiveTarget: Beat generic national-brokerage profile pages by leading with verified facts, concrete origin story, real Google reviews, and direct-broker accountability — zero marketing-speak (CLAUDE.md Data Accuracy + brand voice).
note: KB (kinetic-brutalist) conversion 2026-06-18 (Phase 9 convergence). KbNav + KbFooter carry chrome. Every verified fact: Ryan Realty LLC (OREA 201253677, founded June 2023), Matt PB OR #201206613, fire service + Red Erickson mentor from verified broker bio. Region pulse feeds KbSell live numbers. Hero uses getSurfaceImage central-oregon with Old Mill fallback.
